notes: Governmental funds are modified cash basis (cash basis recorded); utility funds (Electric, Water, Sewer, Trash) are accrual and recorded as business-type with measure net position. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5). Beginning/ending cash are the governmental fund balances (3,407,357 / 3,366,360, p5), which the statement rolls forward; balance sheet cash and deposits total 3,370,784 less payroll liabilities 4,424 (p4). Transfers net to zero in the total column (GF -40,000 / nonmajor +40,000), so transfers_in/out are null. Identity: 3,407,357 + 1,988,758 - 2,029,755 = 3,366,360. Business-type: 13,998,156 + 5,094,015 - 4,031,568 = 15,060,603 (receipts/disbursements totals computed; grants 780,356 are nonoperating revenue per p7). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1), which mixes modified cash (governmental) and accrual (business-type) figures. Component unit (Community Redevelopment Authority) excluded. Proprietary cash-flow section filled from p8 even though governmental basis is cash; no noncapital financing section printed. Detail: General Fund recorded from the departments combining schedule (pp14-15, more detailed) rather than the General Fund budget schedule (p10), to avoid double counting; budget_final given on department lines only where the budget schedule line equals the whole line (Administrative-only taxes, licenses; Park grants), otherwise null. Street and Sales Tax funds from budget schedules (pp11-12); seven nonmajor funds use the Total column (p13). Cemetery spending (38,841) is under Public works in the statement but categorized health/welfare in detail. Franchise 333,911 is the electric fund's franchise fee paid to the General Fund (appears as business-type expense and governmental revenue). No proprietary budget schedules in trimmed pages. Attempt 2 (charges-for-services re-check): business-type 'Other revenue' 7,521 (p7) moved from charges for services/fees to other (category_decisions.csv 'other revenue'), since the report gives no breakdown of it; the governmental 'Charges for services' lines are printed as such and stay.
